snippet.title: Mortal Shell 2 - Official Accolades Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Accolades Trailer for Mortal Shell 2, a third-person action soulslike game developed by PlayStack. Explore a dark fantasy world to take on false gods, leverage weapon upgrades, and possess the Shells of eight lost warriors to seek the truth behind deep secrets. Mortal Shell 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
